name: IEEE Xplore
description: Access technical literature in engineering and technology including journals, conference proceedings, and standards.

name: Google Scholar
description: Search across many disciplines and sources: articles, theses, books, abstracts and court opinions.

name: ACM Digital Library
description: The world's largest computing-specific digital library with full-text articles from ACM publications.

name: arXiv
description: Open-access repository of electronic preprints in physics, mathematics, computer science, and more.

name: PubMed
description: Free search engine accessing primarily the MEDLINE database of references on life sciences and biomedical topics.

name: Scopus
description: The largest abstract and citation database of peer-reviewed literature with smart analytics tools.

name: SpringerLink
description: Access to millions of scientific documents from journals, books, series, protocols, and reference works.

name: ResearchGate
description: Professional network for scientists and researchers to share papers, ask questions, and find collaborators.
